low.title: Full-Day Hallstatt Nature Route on a Low Budget
low.summary: A full day of scenic lake walks, easy forest trails, refreshing waterfall spots, and affordable local bites.

schedule.title: Morning Lakeside Warm-Up
schedule.description: Start your day with a peaceful walk along Hallstätter See — crisp air, calm water, and perfect reflections.

schedule.title: Forest Path to the Waterfall
schedule.description: Follow the town’s shaded upper paths toward Mühlbach waterfall — a refreshing natural stop.

schedule.title: Budget Snack Break
schedule.description: Grab a pretzel, pastry, or simple sandwich before heading to the next viewpoint.

schedule.title: Ridge Path with Mountain Views
schedule.description: Continue along forest trails that open up to occasional views of the lake and mountains.

schedule.title: Low-Cost Local Lunch
schedule.description: Choose a simple Austrian meal — warm, filling, and perfect after a light hike.

schedule.title: Lakeside Trail Extension
schedule.description: Walk the quieter side of the lake for peaceful nature sounds and scenic breaks.

schedule.title: Sunset by the Water
schedule.description: End the day sitting near the lakeshore, watching the mountains change color.

medium.title: Balanced Full-Day Hallstatt Nature Experience
medium.summary: A comfortable day in Hallstatt’s natural world — forest paths, panoramic viewpoints, waterfalls, and mid-range meals.

schedule.title: Café Breakfast with Lake View
schedule.description: Enjoy a light morning meal as you watch the calm water and mountains wake up.

schedule.title: Skywalk Panoramic Start
schedule.description: Take the funicular up to the Skywalk for a breathtaking view over the entire region.

schedule.title: Medium Local Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy a hearty Austrian dish before hitting the forest trails.

schedule.title: Forest Trail to the Waterfall
schedule.description: Walk through cool, shaded forest paths toward the Mühlbach waterfall.

schedule.title: Mountain Terrace Relaxation
schedule.description: Take a break at a viewpoint or open area with mountain breezes.

schedule.title: Lakeside Nature Loop
schedule.description: Enjoy a slow walk along the water — perfect for photos and fresh air.

schedule.title: Evening Nature Reflection
schedule.description: Sit by the lake and enjoy the peaceful end of the day.

high.title: High-End Hallstatt Nature Day
high.summary: A premium outdoor day with curated viewpoints, mountain air, lakeside serenity, and refined local dining.

schedule.title: Scenic Breakfast with Alpine Charm
schedule.description: Start with a beautiful breakfast overlooking the lake and mountains.

schedule.title: Skywalk + Mountain Views
schedule.description: Enjoy unrivaled alpine panoramas from Hallstatt’s most iconic natural viewpoint.

schedule.title: Premium Lunch with Lake Scenery
schedule.description: Savor refined dishes made with local alpine ingredients.

schedule.title: Upper Nature Trail Exploration
schedule.description: Walk higher-elevation routes with forest scents, shade, and scenic breakpoints.

schedule.title: Waterfall Area Photography
schedule.description: Capture beautiful shots of flowing mountain water and dramatic natural textures.

schedule.title: Quiet Lakeside Path
schedule.description: Return down to the peaceful lake path for afternoon calm.

schedule.title: Dinner with Sunset Mountain Views
schedule.description: End your outdoor adventure with a well-prepared dinner overlooking golden-hour reflections.

comfortable.title: Luxury Hallstatt Nature Journey
comfortable.summary: A curated full-day nature experience featuring the finest alpine viewpoints, forest walks, peaceful lake moments, and elegant dining.

schedule.title: Luxury Breakfast with Mountain Panorama
schedule.description: Begin your day with upscale breakfast in a scenic lakeside or mountain-view hotel.

schedule.title: Private Skywalk Visit
schedule.description: Enjoy the iconic viewpoint with time for quiet appreciation and photography.

schedule.title: Fine Dining Alpine Lunch
schedule.description: Indulge in beautifully crafted dishes inspired by mountain flavors.

schedule.title: Exclusive Forest Path Walk
schedule.description: Stroll through serene forest trails surrounded by fresh alpine air.

schedule.title: Waterfall Viewing & Relaxation
schedule.description: Spend time near the waterfall enjoying natural white noise and cool breezes.

schedule.title: Premium Lakeside Walk
schedule.description: Follow the panoramic lakeside path with unmatched peaceful scenery.

schedule.title: Elegant Dinner + Golden Hour Lake Views
schedule.description: End with a fine meal as the sun sets behind alpine peaks.
